start: Workout tab, member follows a plan, nothing done today

user_sees: Up next card with the routine name and 'N exercises from your plan'
Days trained this week (Monday to Sunday)
must_not: A routine other than the one the Today page shows
A days-this-week count different from the This week widget

user_sees: The same routine name and line

start: Home-screen widget and workout reminder, same member

steps.action: Look at the widget and the next reminder
user_sees: The same next routine as the Workout tab card
must_not: A reminder naming a routine the tab does not show

start: No plan followed; the member last did a routine from folder 'PPL'

user_sees: Up next: the next routine of that folder, with the folder named
must_not: Up next lost after 30 empty workouts in a row

start: Member with no plan and no folders, or a plan whose routines have no exercises

user_sees: 'No plan yet' · 'Pick a program or build one'
or 'Your plan has no exercises yet' · 'Add exercises to a routine in <folder>'
must_not: A Start that opens an empty routine without a word

start: Member who just finished today's routine 'Push A'

must_not: Push A offered again as Up next today

steps.action: Delete today's Push A workout in History, come back
user_sees: Up next shows Push A again

start: First open after updating from the version with 5 tabs

user_sees: 'Home, History and Progress now live under Workout and Profile.'
must_not: The notice on a fresh install

start: Phone locked on the table with the MettleUp widget on the home screen

steps.action: Someone else looks at the home screen
user_sees: Only the next routine name and days trained
must_not: Body weight, gym details or workout notes on the widget
